name: Do I need a plumber or electrician during countertop installation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a plumber or electrician during countertop installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, replacing countertops often involves disconnecting and reconnecting sinks, faucets, and garbage disposals, as well as unplugging cooktops. Countertop installers focus on setting the stone, while licensed trade work requires specialized coordination. As a hands-on general contractor, HH Remodeling manages this transition so homeowners do not have to find separate contractors. Abraham coordinates the plumbing disconnect before tear-out and brings in licensed sub-trades to complete final plumbing and electrical connections once the slabs and under-mount sinks are secured.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Sinks, faucets, and cooktops must be disconnected before installation and reconnected afterward. HH Remodeling coordinates these plumbing and electrical sub-trades for you.
